view: PA frontal chest radiograph (erect), L marker at image top-right (patient's left) confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate. Fair inspiration (approximately 9 posterior ribs), no significant rotation (medial clavicle ends roughly equidistant from spinous processes), trachea midline. Penetration slightly low with the abdomen and retrocardiac area under-exposed. Arms at the sides so both scapulae project over the upper-lateral lung fields; humeri and soft tissue of the upper arms included in the field. No motion blur.

abnormalities.finding: Coarse reticular / linear (interstitial-type) opacities in the medial right lower zone, adjacent to the right heart border and extending down to the right hemidiaphragm, partially silhouetting the right heart border; suggests chronic fibrotic / bronchiectatic change of the right middle or lower lobe
Mildly prominent right hilum with increased peri-hilar markings, likely related to the adjacent lower-zone reticular change
Subtle increase in peri-hilar / lower-zone interstitial markings on the left, much less than the right (equivocal)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA站立），吸氣尚可、無明顯旋轉，氣管居中；未見任何導管、導線、心律調節器或體外裝置。右下肺野內側（右心緣旁延伸至右橫膈上方）可見粗糙網狀及條索狀高密度影，使右心緣輪廓部分模糊，右肺門略顯突出；左肺野大致清晰，僅左下肺野肺門周圍紋理略增。雙側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸；心影大小正常、縱隔未增寬，左橫膈下可見胃泡，骨骼與軟組織未見明顯異常。
